desc: Translated complex business requirements into interactive user interfaces for construction and pharma ERPs. Successfully reduced UI-related bug reports by 30% through rigorous cross-browser testing and debugging. Spearheaded the transition from static templates to dynamic React-based architectures for client-facing apps.

Developed interactive client storefronts and responsive admin dashboards. Integrated secure RESTful APIs, optimized state management for high-volume data records, and improved cross-browser performance.
Engineered modular UI components, implemented client-side validation and authentication flows, and collaborated in Agile sprints to ship reliable software releases.
Completed intensive training in full-stack software development workflows, clean code architecture, Git version control, and frontend engineering principles.
